tema:
Tema:o segredo da ilha proibida 

Narração: inglês 

Protagonista:uma mulher de 28 anos morena de cabelos cacheados
legenda: Ela só queria encontrar o irmão, mas acabou descobrindo a verdade sombria da ilha! 🏝️ O que você faria nessa situação aterrorizante? Comente aqui embaixo! #Mistério #Terror #HistoriasAssustadoras #IlhaProibida
falas: I set foot on the forbidden island to find my missing brother, but the island was already watching me.
Ancient signs warned that no human could stay after sunset, yet the heavy mist trapped me completely shorebound.
Deep inside the dark jungle, whispery voices echoed my real name, calling from high up in the trees.
I found my brother's jacket abandoned near an old stone lighthouse whose lantern began to glow on its own.
Inside the tower, old diary pages revealed the island wasn't uninhabited; it feeds on lost souls every midnight.
Suddenly, the shadows on the wall detached themselves and moved straight toward me as the clock struck twelve.
If you woke up trapped on a forbidden island tonight, would you fight the darkness or try to hide?
